steps.dfa:
accepting_states: S2
alphabet: has_key, key_lost
initial_state: S1
states: S1, S2, S3
transitions:
  (S1, !has_key&!key_lost) -> S2
  (S1, !has_key&key_lost) -> S3
  (S1, has_key) -> S2
  (S2, !has_key&!key_lost) -> S2
  (S2, !has_key&key_lost) -> S3
  (S2, has_key) -> S2
  (S3, !has_key) -> S3
  (S3, has_key) -> S2
steps.reward_machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
ACCEPTING_STATES: u0
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
HARD_FAILED_REWARD: -1
SOFT_FAILED_REWARD: -0.5
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !has_key&key_lost) -> u1
(u1, has_key) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !has_key&key_lost, u1) -> -0.1
(u1, has_key, u0) -> 0.1
PENDING_PROMISES:
u1: hard 1, soft 0

tasks.task: Whenever you drop the key, pick it up again
